book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Maluku

content: Yecho ajhingii ku Yeluchalemo kwa ilulo
Yecho na bhabholwa bhake pibhabhandikila kuhika ku Yeluchalemo bhajhakuhika ku Betifage na ku Betaniya, bhakabhandikii pakitombe cha ku Micheitune. Yecho ajhakwatuma bhabholwa bhake bhabhele,
ajhakwalobholela, “Nnyende muchenda imuibhona. Na pumujhingila mu chenda yenio, namumona litole lya liponda bhalikongile, lyamela anatumbu jhe kutami mundo. Na mulibhopole na nhwike nalyo pamba.
Anda mundo ankonyite, ‘Bho, mikabhopola?’ Munnobholele, ‘Bhambo ampala namujhicha kabhele ngoheno.’ ”
Bhahe, bhajhakujhenda, bhajhakunkolela kaponda bhakakongii pa nnyango gwa nyumba pandela. Pibhabhopwila,
bhando bhubhakibha bhajhemite peniya bhajhakwakonya, “Nhwalo gwa nike mukabhopo kaponda?”
Bhabholwa bhakajhangwii ngita Yecho chakabhalobhalile, na bhando bhala bhajhakwaleka bhajhende nako.
Bhabholwa bhajhakumpelekela Yecho kaponda. Bhajhakujhala ngobho yabhe panane jha liponda na Yecho ajhakuhobhokela na kutama panane jhake.
Bhando bhamahele bhajhakujhala ngobho yabhe mundela, bhange bhajhakujhala matuto gha mikongo ghibhakapengwii kumighonda.
Bhando bhoha bhibhakalongalile na bhibhankengima, bhajhakunonoha malobhe ghabhe bhalongela, “Ulombo kwa Chapanga! Tuhanganile jwenio jwahika kwa liina lya Bhambo!
Ghuna mota unahota nkolongwa ghuhika gwa tate gwito Daude. Ulombo kwa Chapanga jwa kunane!”

Yecho ajhakujhingii kubomane jha ku Yeluchalemo ajhakujhenda ade mu Nyumba jha Chapanga, ajhakulingukiya kila kilebhe. Nhwalo ikibha kimihe, ajhakujhenda ku Betaniya pamonga na bhabholwa bhake kome na bhabhele.
Yecho aulapanikii nkongo nkojho
Lukela jhake, pubhabhokita ku Betaniya, Yecho ajhakubhona njala.

Bhahe, ajhakubhona nkongo gwa nkojho chakutale ubhii na mahamba ghamahena ajhakuheghelela alinge pange upambike uhohe. Pauheghelila, akaukoli upambike ndeka nga mahamba tugha, ukahikite ndeka muda gwa kupambika.
Peniya ajhakuulongelela nkongo ghola, “Kutumbulii deleno na machiko ghoha mundo jhojhoha nalyejhe uhohe kuhumii munkongo hogho.” Na bhabholwa bhake bhakajhohine malobhe gheniya.
Yecho ajhingii munyumba jha Chapanga

Bhahe, bhakahikite ku Yeluchalemo, Yecho ajhakujhingii mu Nyumba jha Chapanga na kutumbuu kwabhenga bhando panja bhibhachulwicha na kuhemela ilebhe mwenio. Ajhakupendengula njangwale ya bhando bhala bhubhakibha bhajhangangina mbijha, na igoda ya bhala bhibhachulwicha ngunda.
Akabhakanakii bhando kupeta ndeka pulubhanja jwakapitite na kilebhe chochoha mu Nyumba jha Chapanga.
Peniya ajhakwabhola, “Ijhandikwe, ‘Nyumba jhango nahibha nyumba jha kunnyope Chapanga kwa bhando bha ilambo yoha.’ Mangota mwenga uyohite nkwembe gwa kukwatulila ilebhe!”
Akapiya matambiko bhakolo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo pibhajhohina gheniya, bhakatumbwii kupalaha kihokola chakupala kunkoma. Bhakajhogwipe nhwalo gwa lilongo lya bhando ghukangicha mabholo ghake.
Pikihikita kimihe, Yecho na bhabholwa bhake bhakabhokite ku bomane.
Mabholo gha nkongo ghujhomite
Putiputi, pubhapetita, bhajhakubhona nkongo gwa nkojho ghola ujhomite chwaa, mikegha ade kukilegheleghe chake.
Petile akaukombwike nkongo ghola, ajhakunobholela Yecho, “Mmola, dolekeya! Nkojho ghola ghumulapanikiya, ujhomite!”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Muhobholele Chapanga.
Ninobholela chakaka, mundo anda akilobholile kitombe chenje heghela hoko, mukitaghile kumbwane, changakiholo ku mwojho gwake, anda ahobholela ghoha ghalongii naghatendeka, natendelwa kilebhe i.
Nambo ninobholela, piminyopa kilebhe chochoha Chapanga, na unhobholela nampokela.
Pimijhema na kunnyopa Chapanga, tunnekekehe kila mundo jwalemwite, Tate gwito jwa kunane kwa Chapanga nanekekeya na mangota hele ghunemwite.
Nambo changalekekeya bhange bhibhalemwite, na Tate gwino jwa kunane nannekekeya ndeka mangota mwe ghinnemwite.”
Bhando bhakonya uhotolo gwa Yecho
Bhahe, bhajhakuhika kabhele ku Yeluchalemo. Yecho pakibha atyangita pa Nyumba jha Chapanga, akapiya matambiko bhakolo, bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo na ighogholo bhajhakunyendelela,
bhajhakunkonya Yecho, “Bho, mihenga ghanga kwa ukindendeke gwa ghane? Na ghane jwampekiye mwenga ukindendeke gwa kuhenga gheniya?”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Nipala kunkonya kilebhe chimo. Anda unyangwii, na nenga naninobholela nihenga ilebhe henge kwa ukindendeke gwa ghane.
Bho, ukindendeke gwa Yohane gwa kubaticha uhumita ko, kunane kwa Chapanga amu kwa bhando? Unyangule.”
Bhajhakutumbuu kukonyana, “Anda tulongii, ‘Ghahuma kwa Chapanga,’ nalongela, ‘Bho, nhwalo ghane mukajheketii ndeka?’
Akakolo bha matambiko na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo anda tulongii, ‘Uhumita kwa bhando,’ naibha bho?” Bhakalijhogwipe lilongo lya bhando bhakamanyite chakaka Yohane akibha Nnondole jwa Chapanga.
Bhahe, bhajhakunnyanguu Yecho, “Twenga timanyitejhe.” Na jwenio Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Na nenga naninobholela ndeka nihenga ghanga kwa ukindendeke gwa ghane.”
